correctness.rationale: The path basis and concatenation give the complete x² equations after diagonal elimination. For each independent arrow support the equations split gapwise; gap lengths 2,3,at least 4 impose 1,1,2 independent linear constraints on disjoint c-coordinates. A unit-coefficient pivot makes each support stratum a trivial torus-affine bundle, proving all fields and motivating the Grothendieck and finite-field identities. Each stratum has dimension 2n-h; maximal supports have h=0 and their closures, with the zero-support component, exhaust all dimension-2n components. Cyclic distinguished-gap counting proves the rational GF. A standalone direct checker confirms finite instances, but is not used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: This is an all-length, all-characteristic motivic classification of a natural power-map fiber in the standard self-injective cyclic Nakayama family. The exact number of top-dimensional components is a nontrivial Perrin-sequence bridge, and the stratification additionally produces all finite-extension point counts and a rational normalized length generating series. These are natural structural/arithmetic invariants for the entire family, not an arbitrary cutoff or routine numerical table.
